[[SeaScape]]'s '''Aquasuit (Hardshell model)''' was a [[Rubber/Legends|rubber]] [[diving suit]] with reinforced ribbing and plates to allow for dives up to 200 [[Meter/Legends|meters]]. The suit's air tanks contained enough [[Oxygen/Legends|oxygen]] for six [[Standard hour/Legends|hours]], and the suit included built in flippers and propulsion unit. The helmet included a [[Comlink/Legends|comlink]] with a range of two [[Kilometer/Legends|kilometers]].
